How to play

  1. Tap or drag to drop dots, or load a set.
  2. Press Step to watch the two moves one at a time, or Play to run to the end.
  3. Change k, then check the elbow chart: which k fits best?

What's happening?

  • Nobody tells the computer what the groups are. It finds them by itself. That's unsupervised learning.
  • It drops k centres (the big markers) at random spots.
  • Move 1, assign: every dot joins its nearest centre and takes its colour.
  • Move 2, update: every centre jumps to the middle of its dots. The trail shows where it went.
  • Repeat until nobody switches. The spread (how far dots are from their centres) can only shrink.

Try this: load Uneven sizes with k = 3 and press Play. Did it find the two small groups? Press New start a few times. Does it always get the same answer?
